title: Zero Fourier coefficient as an affine average
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a real-valued function on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$, let $H$ be a linear subspace of $\mathbb{F}_2^n$, and let $z\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. The zero Fourier coefficient of the restriction of $f$ to the affine subspace $H+z$ equals the uniform average of $f(h+z)$ over $h\in H$.
